notes: New: the walk between points of interest has more texture now. Maps occasionally roll a "condition" — a bit more shrine-rich, a vault day, or just plain loot-dense — with a small chance of bonus loot near the Gate either way.
New: rare, quiet moments while exploring open ground — a short flavor line and a small guaranteed reward, no battle, no minigame.

New: Seed Landmarks — a small chance any map clusters several of the same find together instead of scattering them: a run of vaults, a web of Locked Nodes, an anomaly pocket with better odds at something Marked, and biome-specific finds in Frostbyte Tundra and the Ghost Server. Rare enough to be worth hunting and sharing a seed for.
Changed: Packet Tracer and Port Scanner now also have a passive use — they'll let you know if a map has one of these rare finds on it (never what or where).
New: on rare Layer 1 maps, a biome's own Layer 2 hazard can show up faintly — a few more heat vents, a touch tighter fog — never enough to feel like Layer 2 itself.
